name: supo-codegym-compat13probe-h100
description: 1-GPU probe: does CUDA 13.0 forward-compat libcuda (580.126.20) initialize on the R535 pod driver?

job_template_config.entrypoint_full_script:
set -x; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version --format=csv,noheader | head -1; cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version | head -1
mkdir -p /tmp/c13 && tar xzf /mnt/hdfs/mlsys/users/xiaoxuan/supo_codegym/job-assets/cuda-13.0-compat.tar.gz -C /tmp/c13 && ls /tmp/c13/compat
cat > /tmp/cuinit.py <<'PY'
import ctypes, sys
path = sys.argv[1]
try:
    lib = ctypes.CDLL(path)
except OSError as e:
    print(f"[{path}] dlopen FAILED: {e}"); sys.exit(0)
rc = lib.cuInit(0); v = ctypes.c_int(0); lib.cuDriverGetVersion(ctypes.byref(v))
ndev = ctypes.c_int(0); rc2 = lib.cuDeviceGetCount(ctypes.byref(ndev))
name = ctypes.create_string_buffer(256); dev = ctypes.c_int(0); rc3 = lib.cuDeviceGet(ctypes.byref(dev), 0); lib.cuDeviceGetName(name, 256, dev)
print(f"[{path}] cuInit rc={rc} (0=OK, 803=SYSTEM_DRIVER_MISMATCH, 999=UNKNOWN, 100=NO_DEVICE) driver_api_version={v.value} devices={ndev.value} dev0={name.value.decode(errors='ignore')}")
PY
echo "=== default (image) libcuda ==="; python3 /tmp/cuinit.py libcuda.so.1
echo "=== CUDA 13.0 compat libcuda ==="; python3 /tmp/cuinit.py /tmp/c13/compat/libcuda.so.1
echo "=== CUDA 13.0 compat via LD_LIBRARY_PATH ==="; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/c13/compat python3 /tmp/cuinit.py libcuda.so.1
exit 0
